ABOUT US

Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets by automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners—specifically in cybersecurity, privacy, and financial audits. We build software for the people who enable trust between businesses.

We're based in San Francisco, CA, and built remote-first. We're backed by Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, and more. Over 50 of the top 100 accounting and consulting firms trust Fieldguide to power mission-critical work.

We value diversity — in backgrounds and in experiences. We need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of audit and advisory. Fieldguide's team is inclusive, driven, humble and supportive. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture that we are building, seeking teammates that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.




ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll join a genuine 0→1 team on the ground floor of one of the company's biggest new bets. You will work full-stack on long-horizon agents, ship features that do real audit work, and work alongside practitioners.

Depending on your experience and what you're looking to own, you may join building within a major agent area, owning one end-to-end, or setting technical direction for agentic audit work across the team. We're hiring across all levels and will calibrate during interviews based on scope and demonstrated experience.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and build agent-driven experiences for SOX control testing, deciding where autonomy makes sense and where the auditor stays in the loop

 - Own complex, end-to-end workstreams across the full stack

 - Make long agentic runs trustworthy: improve reliability, repeatability, performance, and observability so the same evidence produces the same defensible conclusion every time

 - Turn agent output into finished audit deliverables, including structured workpapers that adapt to whatever template a firm brings

 - Ship code from day one and ramp quickly into full ownership of significant product areas

 - Collaborate daily with product managers, designers, and SOX subject matter experts to work through difficult domain problems

 - Help shape technical direction and contribute to how the team thinks about agentic systems, AI tooling, and engineering best practices




WHO YOU ARE (ALL LEVELS)

 - A strong full-stack engineer who writes code every day and wants to continue doing so

 - You've built with LLMs in production, not just in prototypes. You know what breaks when real users and real documents hit an agent

 - Comfortable in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where you figure things out as you go

 - Energized by 0→1 work: you'd rather define the problem than inherit a spec

 - High degree of ownership; you don't wait to be told what to do

 - A genuine team player across the organization, not just within engineering. You'll work directly with PM, design, domain experts, and customer-facing teams, and you treat that as the best part of the job

 - Able to pick up complex domain concepts quickly. You don't need to know SOX or internal controls, but you're the kind of person who can internalize it fast

 - Already using AI coding tools in your workflow and curious about where agentic approaches create real leverage




HIGHER-LEVEL RESPONSIBILITIES

At the Senior level, you may:

 - Lead complex projects or systems, setting technical direction and ensuring long-term health

 - Collaborate with PMs and designers to shape roadmaps and define architectural tradeoffs

 - Serve as a domain expert within one or more technical areas (e.g., agent orchestration, evaluation and quality, document processing, frontend architecture)

 - Mentor other engineers and help raise the technical bar across the team

At the Staff level, you may:

 - Drive company-level technical initiatives and influence cross-team architecture

 - Set and champion engineering standards for scalability, security, and performance

 - Partner with engineering and product leadership to define long-term technical strategy

 - Serve as a trusted advisor to leaders across Engineering, Product, and Design

 - Represent Fieldguide externally through writing, speaking, and open-source contributions




EXPERIENCE

Must-have:

 - Shipped LLM-backed product features to production against real users

 - Comfortable full-stack, with enough backend depth to work in agent orchestration

 - Autonomy working from an ambiguous spec

 - A collaborative mindset with an ability to work across PM, design, and domain experts

 - Willingness to develop an Applied AI skillset including writing evals, using LLM observability tools, and being thoughtful about quality

**General Function**
 The Principal AI Engineer designs and builds artificial intelligence systems that address complex business challenges and deliver measurable value with a focus on agentic AI. This role functions as a forward\-deployed engineer partnering with product owners, lines\-of\-business, engineering, security, risk, and compliance to identify high\-impact opportunities, and deliver safe and effective agentic AI solutions.
   

  

 This role focuses on AI for the Customer by using generative AI predominantly in AWS to deliver operational efficiency and superior customer experience. The Principal AI Engineer develops AI agents that leverage reasoning, planning, retrieval, and tools to complete complex tasks; establishes evaluation and documentation practices; monitors production performance; and produces evidence needed for governance.
   

  

 This role communicates complex AI concepts, risks, opportunities, and recommendations clearly to technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior leaders while supporting the Bank’s business goals and remaining within risk appetite.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
**AI Development and Implementation**
* Design and build generative AI and/or agentic systems that solve business problems and deliver measurable value
* Develop AI agents that use reasoning, planning, retrieval, and tool integration to complete complex tasks
* Evaluate AI agents before and after their deployment to drive continuous improvement and ensure effectiveness of AI systems
* Research, prototype, and apply emerging AI models, agent frameworks, orchestration patterns, and enterprise development practices


**Analytics and Insights**
* Design and execute experiments to evaluate prompts, retrieval strategies, agent workflows, tool integrations, and user experience
* Conduct data analysis to compare prompts, workflows, and tools across runtime, accuracy, and output quality; report results for governance processes; and quantify return on investment for AI solutions
* Use supervised and unsupervised learning techniques to understand customer needs on the channels we support to inform decision making.
* Define success metrics for each AI use case, such as containment, time to resolution, customer satisfaction, or sentiment.
* Monitor agent performance in production, including latency, failure rates, tool\-call success, escalation rates, retry behavior, and cost per interaction
* Produce evidence for AI governance reviews, including evaluation results, control effectiveness, model/tool performance, and risk mitigation outcomes


**Collaboration and Communication**
* Deliver complex AI projects and cross\-team initiatives with limited supervision, ensuring solutions are integrated, scalable, and compliant
* Serve as a technical authority for colleagues by influencing architectural decisions, and shaping engineering standards across products and platforms
* Partner with product owners and line\-of\-business teams to understand day\-to\-day workflows, identify automation opportunities, and translate business needs into well\-defined AI and agentic use cases with clear objectives, constraints, and success criteria
* Educate technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior leaders on AI concepts, solution designs, recommendations, opportunities, and emerging trends through clear, practical guidance
* Collaborate with software engineers, cloud engineers, data engineers, and data scientists to integrate AI solutions into existing systems and products
* Work with compliance, security, and risk teams to ensure AI systems meet governance, regulatory, and responsible AI requirements before and after deployment


**Education And Experience**
**Minimum Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or related technical field; advanced degree preferred but not required
* 6\+ years of experience developing software or AI solutions in production environments


**Technical Skills**
* Strong programming skills in Python, Typescript, Java, Go, or similar languages used for AI engineering and software development
* Expertise in generative AI techniques, e.g. context engineering, LLM fine\-tuning, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), evaluation frameworks, model context protocol (MCP), loop/graph engineering, skills/open knowledge format, and agentic system design
* Experience with cloud computing platforms, preferred (especially AWS)
* Familiarity with prompt optimization, retrieval tuning, caching, and model selection to improve generative AI performance, latency, cost, and reliability
* Knowledge of agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, Strands, Google ADK, Anthropic sdk, or OpenAI sdk


**Engineering Practices**
* Proficiency with version control systems (Git/GitHub)
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
* Experience with containerization and Infrastructure as Code (Docker, Terraform)
* Knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles
* Experience designing observability systems for AI applications preferred


**Business And Soft Skills**
* Demonstrates curiosity and adaptability by quickly learning new skills, techniques, tools, and frameworks as AI technologies and business needs evolve.
* Communicates clearly, builds consensus, and presents ideas effectively in written and verbal formats.
* Promotes knowledge sharing and supports strong cross\-team collaboration.
* Uses sound analytical judgment to solve problems, prioritize competing demands, and work independently.
* Works well in Agile environments and with standard business productivity tools.
* Understands ethical considerations and responsible practices for AI deployment.
